# 📚 05 - ckb-ssri-std API Map (docs.rs Companion)

**Module**: Week 7 - SSRI Track (Part 5/7)  
**Author**: Riko Kurnia Sandi  
**Official Reference**: [ckb-ssri-std 0.0.1 on docs.rs](https://docs.rs/ckb-ssri-std/0.0.1/ckb_ssri_std/)

---

## 1. Overview

docs.rs renders the rustdoc of the exact tarball verified in module 02. Instead of screenshots of web pages, this module vendors that **byte-identical source** (`vendor/ckb-ssri-std-0.0.1/`, sha256 `3ce0963e...6c63580`) and maps its public API mechanically — offline-verifiable by anyone.

## 2. API Map (9 files, generated by [`scripts/sdk_api_map_demo.js`](./scripts/sdk_api_map_demo.js))

| File | Public surface |
| :--- | :--- |
| `lib.rs` | `SSRIError::{SSRIMethodsNotFound, ArgsInvalid, NotImplemented, RequireHigherLevel, InvalidVmVersion}` |
| `macros.rs` | re-export `ckb_ssri_std_proc_macro::*` (`ssri_methods!`) |
| `prelude.rs` | `encode/decode_u64_vector`, `encode/decode_u8_32_vector` |
| `public_module_traits/udt.rs` | `UDT` (transfer/verify_transfer/name/symbol/decimals/icon/mint/verify_mint), `UDTPausable` (pause/unpause/is_paused/enumerate_paused), `UDTError`, `UDTPausableError`, `UDTPausableData{pause_list, next_type_script}`, `ScriptLike`, `UDT_LEN=16` |
| `utils/high_level.rs` | `find_out_point_by_type`, `find_cell_by_out_point`, `find_cell_data_by_out_point` |
| `utils/syscalls/native.rs` | `SYS_* = 2277/2287/2297`, `vm_version()`, native find_* impls |
| `utils/mod.rs` | `should_fallback()` (no argv[0] → verifier path) |

Notes: `simulator` module is **feature-gated** (`native-simulator`) and absent from the default build; method tables in doc-comments were excluded from the count (naive grep would false-positive on `unified_dispatch`/`get_methods` examples).
